name: CaseHardSvgGlyphStroke
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-svg-glyph-stroke" (glyph). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: inline <svg><path> check glyph drawn with stroke, stroke-width and stroke-linecap
